CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `user_analytics` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `user_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `discord_id` varchar(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `session_id` varchar(128) DEFAULT NULL,
  `ip_address` varchar(45) DEFAULT NULL,
  `user_agent` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `browser_name` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `browser_version` varchar(50) DEFAULT NULL,
  `os_name` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `os_version` varchar(50) DEFAULT NULL,
  `device_type` varchar(50) DEFAULT NULL,
  `screen_resolution` varchar(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `timezone` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `language` varchar(10) DEFAULT NULL,
  `referrer` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `cookies` longtext CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin DEFAULT NULL CHECK (json_valid(`cookies`)),
  `local_storage` longtext CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin DEFAULT NULL CHECK (json_valid(`local_storage`)),
  `fingerprint` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL,
  `geolocation` longtext CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin DEFAULT NULL CHECK (json_valid(`geolocation`)),
  `created_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp(),
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `idx_user_analytics` (`user_id`,`created_at`),
  KEY `idx_fingerprint` (`fingerprint`),
  KEY `idx_ip` (`ip_address`),
  KEY `idx_discord_id` (`discord_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `user_analytics_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=644 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;
